seal: no session >= 2024-01-01 (asserted on the trade table, the panel and the joined frame)
outcome: u = gross_usd / (usd_pp * entry_price * sig20(root, session) * sqrt(hold_min / 390))

method.subset: per cell, the object's trades with finite X; NaN-X trades enter neither fit, prediction nor the cell's means
method.loyo: OLS u = a + b X on the other years' subset trades (2022 in the training set when Y != 2022); u_hat_Y = mean fitted value over Y's subset trades
method.phi: (u_hat_2022 - ubar_R) / (ubar_2022 - ubar_R) on the cell's subset; ubar_R pooled over non-2022 trades
method.se: cluster-robust by ISO week (isoyear, week) of the session, CR1: c = G/(G-1) (N-1)/(N-K), K = 2; fit excludes 2022
method.p: two-sided normal, erfc(|t|/sqrt 2); Holm step-down across the object's family
method.readings: EXPLAINS: Holm p < 0.05 and phi >= 0.5; PARTIAL: Holm p < 0.05 and 0.2 <= phi < 0.5; NO otherwise (also NO where the cell's subset has no 2022 excess, flagged subset_excess_le_0)
method.joint: OLS on every Holm-passing variable (intercept), outside 2022, trades with all finite; residual share = (ubar_2022 - u_hat_joint_2022) / (ubar_2022 - ubar_R) on that subset
method.object: N/A if ubar_2022 <= ubar_R (all trades); UNEXPLAINED if no cell EXPLAINS and the joint residual share >= 0.5; else NOT_UNEXPLAINED
method.beside: X6_15m and X9_record: the same cell, unadjusted p only, not in any Holm family (D722-A1)

L3.not_read_note: X3 == 1 on every L3 trade (asserted: L3 is gated on short gamma); no fit is possible, so it is reported as not read and is outside the family
